title: Resume Advice That’s Actually Hurting You
description:
If a “career coach” is telling you this resume advice… run.

Most job seekers are following outdated or flat-out wrong advice that’s actually costing them interviews.

In this video, I break down common resume mistakes and myths — including ATS scores, removing dates, only listing the last 10 years of experience, and using generic soft skills like “team player.”

Recruiters are not looking for flashy resumes or keyword stuffing. They are scanning for clarity and looking for proof that you can solve their problem.

If your resume doesn’t make your value obvious fast, you’re getting skipped.

 Want to fix your resume and start getting interviews? Watch my full video where I break this down step-by-step: https://youtu.be/CoD34dtWzkc

transcript: If a career coach tells you to do this with your resume, run. Recruiters are not looking for art projects. They are scanning for clarity. If someone tells you your resume failed the ATS, run. That's not even a thing. If they tell you to remove dates, run even faster. Nothing screams red flags like missing information from a resume. And if they tell you to list soft skills like team player instead of proving it with results in your bullets, you are getting skipped. Good resumes don't play tricks. They make your value obvious fast. I break down exactly how to fix this in my full video. Go watch that next and follow me at Kirchner Career.
